W.note: Nacreous glow (4: na-cre-ous glow) / mother-of-pearl in the dusk (7) / the sky holds its breath (5) is 4-7-5, short a syllable, and the closing line is a stock personification.

X.note: 5 (moth-er-of-pearl cloud) / 7 (pink green gold then on-ly grey) / 5 (my breath still ris-ing); the colour sequence fading to grey and the breath turn land well.

Y.note: 5 (pearl cloud af-ter dusk) / 7 (the pink lets go of its edge) / 5 (one watch-er then grey); fresh image of colour releasing, the lone watcher gives a quiet turn.

Z.note: 5 (moth-er-of-pearl veils) / 7 (na-cre-ous light at dusk slow) / 5-6 (fire on fro-zen air, fire 1 or 2); enjambed 'slow' is awkward but 'fire on frozen air' is accurate to polar stratospheric clouds.
